it: should correctly determine the unit
test: should correctly determine the unit
note: The case asserts only scale._unit of a line chart with a dataset. The probe gives pass and equal values in the modes all and none. The data uses Math.random for y and a moment parse with 'MMM DD YYYY' in the test body only; the port builds the same x values without a moment format.

it: should be bounded by the nearest week beginnings
test: should be bounded by the nearest week beginnings
note: The line chart has a dataset with no data, thus it needs controller.line. The probe gives pass and equal values in the modes all and none. The bounds read getValueForPixel at scale.left and scale.right; the default legend is at the top and does not change the horizontal layout.

it: should convert between screen coordinates and times
test: should convert between screen coordinates and times
note: The probe gives pass and equal values in the modes all and none. The assertions read horizontal pixels and values only, with the matcher toBeCloseToTime of the spec (a moment diff in hours, a test-side helper).

it: should be bounded by nearest step's year start and end
test: should be bounded by nearest step's year start and end
note: Information only: the probe confirms the skip. The chart has no dataset; without the legend, ctx.font at the x fit is not the legend font (plugin.legend.js:143), _getLabelCapacity changes and the unit becomes month, not year. In the mode none the case fails. Skeptic check: the probe gives pass in the mode only:legend and fail in the modes none and without:legend; the other without:<id> modes give pass. Thus the legend alone changes the asserted values.

it: should build the correct ticks
test: should build the correct ticks
note: Information only: the probe confirms the skip. The chart has no dataset; without the legend, ctx.font at the x fit is not the legend font (plugin.legend.js:143), _getLabelCapacity changes and the unit becomes month, not year. In the mode none the labels are "Jul 2005", "Nov 2005", ... Skeptic check: the probe gives pass in the mode only:legend and fail in the modes none and without:legend; the other without:<id> modes give pass. Thus the legend alone changes the asserted values.

it: should get the correct label for a data value

note: The assertions read getLabelForValue of a parsed value through the controller (getParsed) and of a tick pixel. The probe gives pass and equal values in the modes all and none. The default adapter gives the lower-case day period of moment (Chart.js ADR 0024, decision 6).

it: should get the correct labels for ticks

note: The assertions read the count and the text of the tick labels after the auto skip. The probe gives pass and equal values in the modes all and none.

note: The case uses parsing.xAxisKey 't' and reads getLabelForValue of a parsed value. The probe gives pass and equal values in the modes all and none.

it: should get the correct pixel for only one data in the dataset

note: The assertion compares getValueForPixel(getPixelForValue(v)) with v; no plugin changes this round trip. The probe gives pass and equal values in the modes all and none.

it: does not create a negative width chart when hidden
test: does not create a negative width chart when hidden
note: The probe gives unsupported: it has no DOM layout for a wrapper with display: none. The Dart DOM stand-in gives a display: none subtree the size 0 (chartjs_test_utils lib/src/dom.dart, used by core.controller_test.dart), and with a chart width of 0 every box gets 0, so the legend cannot change scales.y.width, scales.y.maxWidth or chart.width. Skeptic check: a probe spec of the same chart with a 0 x 0 canvas and responsive false gives pass and the value 0 for the three assertions in the modes all and none.
